usage: The word '暴雨' is used to describe a heavy rainstorm or downpour.
It is a noun, so it can be the subject or object in a sentence.
'暴雨' often appears with words related to weather conditions or warnings.
It can be combined with time expressions to indicate when the rainstorm occurs.
When describing intensity, '暴雨' emphasizes very strong or intense rain.
